description: Fetch a work by Open Library Work ID (OL…W). Returns title, description, subjects, cover IDs, and linked author IDs for follow-up lookups. Works represent the abstract book concept independent of any specific edition. A merged work ID resolves to the work it was merged into. To reach a work from an ISBN, call openlibrary_get_edition with id_type "isbn" — its work_id output is the parent work. Note: author names are not included — use openlibrary_get_author or openlibrary_search_books for names.

work_id.description: Open Library Work ID. Format: OL…W (e.g., "OL45804W"), optionally prefixed "/works/". Not an ISBN — resolve an ISBN to its work with openlibrary_get_edition (id_type "isbn").

name: openlibrary_get_work

author_ids.description: Open Library Author IDs (OL…A). Use openlibrary_get_author for names and bio.

cover_ids.description: Numeric cover IDs. Pass to openlibrary_get_cover_url with id_type "id".

created.description: ISO 8601 creation timestamp. Absent when not available.

description.description: Work description or blurb. Absent when not provided.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `not_found`: Work ID does not exist on Open Library, or it redirects to no reachable work. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

last_modified.description: ISO 8601 last-modified timestamp. Absent when not available.

notice.description: Set when the requested work ID was merged into a different canonical ID, and when the text output caps a long subject list (naming the omitted count and the complete array in structuredContent). Absent when neither applies.

work_id.description: Canonical Open Library Work ID (OL…W) — differs from the requested work_id when that ID was merged into this work.

title: Get Work
